figurative_meaning_en: To manage the household efficiently and beautifully
similar_in_english: Run a tight ship (in a domestic sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা ঘর গোছানোর ক্ষেত্রে অসাধারণ দক্ষ।
বিয়ের পর সে দ্রুত ঘর গোছানো শিখে নিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She is exceptionally skilled at managing the household.
After marriage, she quickly learned how to run the home efficiently.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali values of domestic harmony and organization.
